messages:
liz: quick sync 1 — small design decision: show SSO control as a compact status chip on role cards or keep it as an inline switch? attached quick mocks. goal: scannability for admins + clear affordance for toggling.
raj: chip is great for scan, but does it allow toggling in place or just show state? if it's static we need a clear path to change it.
liz: idea: chip shows state (SSO on/off). clicking the chip opens a small confirm popover with a labeled switch and 'View affected users' link. on mobile we put it in the kebab.
noah: accessibility and keyboard: popovers can be tricky. make sure the chip is a button (<button aria-pressed>) and opening popover traps focus and sets aria-modal if needed. also ensure popover close on escape.
emma: contrast: chips currently use 12px text on colored bg; fails WCAG 4.5:1. need larger text or stronger color. tooltips must appear on focus and hover.
tess: product question: when toggling SSO on, do we block immediately or require confirmation listing affected users? i'd vote for confirmation to avoid accidental lockouts. also bulk actions need special copy.
raj: agree on confirmation. modal copy suggestion: "Turn on SSO for [Role]? X users do not have SSO configured and will be prevented from signing in." include "View affected users" and checkbox "I understand".
a11y-bot: automated scan results:
- .role-chip text contrast: 3.1:1 (fail)
- popover: missing aria-describedby linking to affected user list
- popover focus trap: not implemented in prototype
- menu items in mobile kebab missing role="menuitem"

liz: action items: 1) design: update chip color & typography and add popover flow (i'll update figma). 2) product (raj/tess): finalize modal and bulk copy. 3) eng (noah): implement chip as button, accessible popover, keyboard nav. 4) a11y (emma/a11y-bot): re-scan after mock.
noah: dev note: prefer popover that contains a simple form: labeled switch (aria-checked), a small summary line, and a link to modal for full list. avoids big modals for quick toggles. bulk toggles should always bring modal.
emma: copy nit: visible label on switch should be short: "SSO enforced"; expand with aria-label: "Require single sign-on for members of this role". Tooltips: "Requires single sign-on for this role."
raj: deep-link to audit: product to spec link format role_id/action=ssotoggle/event_ts. audit page should focus and announce opened item. fall back to filtered view if missing.
tess: scheduling: we should usability test both patterns (chip+popover vs inline switch) with 5 admins next week. i'll book a session.
liz: votes: liz +1 chip+popover, raj +1 but wants clear confirm, noah 0 (prefers inline for keyboard), emma +1 if contrast fixed.
a11y-bot: schedule re-scan once figma link is updated.
liz: thanks team 1 — i'll post updated mocks and tag this thread. :rocket:
